text:
Priya Rao: UX quick-check: the 'Delete organization' confirmation is verbose and a bit cold. Screenshot: https://redwood/mockups/delete-org-modal.png

Jon Carter: Agree. Right now it says: "Deleting this org will remove all projects, billing, and data permanently. This action cannot be undone." Feels alarmist and also repeats info in the modal footer.

Ellen Park: Could we soften the tone and make the call-to-action clearer? Also keyboard order currently puts the destructive action first which is risky.

Samir Gupta: Draft simpler copy: 

```
Headline: "Delete organization"
Body: "This will permanently remove the organization and its projects. Back up any needed data first."
Primary button: [Cancel]
Destructive button: [Delete organization]
```

Notes: Make Cancel the default focus, add a short help link "Learn what this removes" that opens docs, and include `aria-describedby` so screen readers get the body text.

Priya Rao: I like the shorter body but suggest replacing "Back up any needed data first" with "Export important data before deleting" 1 clearer action.

Jon Carter: Also add a tiny inline confirmation checkbox for org owners: "I understand this will permanently delete the org" to reduce accidental deletes for orgs with many projects. Keep checkbox optional for smaller orgs via a conditional rule.

Ellen Park: Accessibility checklist: trap focus, default focus on Cancel, Esc closes the dialog, checkbox must be keyboard accessible and announced, ensure destructive button has `aria-label=\"Delete organization: <org-name>\"`, and visible focus outlines.

Samir Gupta: For localization, avoid idioms like "nuke" or "kill" in copy. Use consistent phrase "permanently delete". Also verify character limits for translated strings in the modal width.

A11yBot: Created task: a11y/dialogs - delete-org modal (focus order, descriptive text, checkbox semantics). Reference: /docs/a11y/dialogs#delete-org.

Priya Rao: I'll update Figma and push a small PR with the revised copy, checkbox behavior, default focus change, and the help link to docs. I'll include screenshots for small and large org flows.

Jon Carter: @Ellen can you review the PR once it's up?

Ellen Park: Yep, will do.

Priya Rao: Thanks all :thumbsup:
